git.repo.notARepo: This folder isn't a git repository.
git.repo.alreadyARepo: This folder is already in a git repository.
git.branch.noUpstream: {{branch}} has no upstream yet: push it first.
git.branch.checkedOut: {{branch}} is checked out: switch to another branch first.
git.pull.diverged: {{current}} and {{upstream}} have diverged, so a fast-forward pull isn't possible. Merge {{upstream}} into {{current}} from the branch menu, or rebase in a terminal.
git.commit.nothingStaged: Nothing is staged. Stage the files to commit first.
git.draft.noResult: Drafting the commit message ended without a result.
git.github.unreadablePr: gh made the pull request, but it can't be read back: {{output}}
git.workspace.outsidePath: Path must be inside the workspace: {{path}}
git.workspace.notImage: Not an image the viewer shows: {{path}}
git.workspace.noFile: No such file in the workspace: {{path}}
git.workspace.badBase: The task's base isn't a commit the app can read.
git.review.unreadable: GitHub's answer about the PR's review couldn't be read.
git.review.noRemote: The workspace's origin isn't a GitHub repository gh can read.
git.revert.hunkGone: That change no longer exists. Refresh the diff.
git.files.symlink: {{path}} is a symbolic link, so AgentChainer won't write through it.
git.create.badName: Give the folder a name without / or \.
